description: RETC is Chile's pollutant release and transfer register, run by the Ministry of the Environment, and its open data portal publishes the waste declarations that municipalities and companies file each year. For waste, the portal has yearly files on municipal waste generation, industrial non-hazardous waste, hazardous waste and its receivers, final receivers of non-hazardous waste, and authorised reception and storage facilities, from 2014 to 2024. The municipal file lists, for each municipality, the tonnes sent to each receiving site, the treatment (such as recycling, co-processing or landfill), the European waste list code, and the coordinates and comuna of both sender and receiver, so it describes a national waste flow network. The files are free and available to download as CSV or XLSX, and through a CKAN API, mostly under Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: figures are self-declared, coverage grows over the years as more establishments report, and formats change between years. Simulation uses: building an origin and destination network of municipal waste flows, testing landfill closure or disruption scenarios, and optimising transfer and treatment capacity. Related records: the Italian ISPRA municipal waste register (data-ispra-catasto-rifiuti-municipal-waste) is a comparable national source, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives totals.
licence: Creative Commons Attribution (most data sets); ODbL for some
